channel.title: Computer Vision on Perception Enabled Digital Agriculture Lab
channel.description: Recent content in Computer Vision on Perception Enabled Digital Agriculture Lab

item.title: Smartphone-Based Irrigation Information in Vineyards
item.description: We developed a simple and fast way to estimate crop water needs in vineyards using just a smartphone and computer vision instead of expensive sensors.

item.title: Inexpensive, Automated Pruning Weight Estimation in Vineyards
item.description: We present a low-cost, computer vision-based approach using smartphones and structured light to estimate vineyard pruning weight, outperforming existing methods for VSP vines and extending to HC vines.

item.title: Automated Vineyard Pruning Weight Estimation
item.description: We developed an inexpensive, easy-to-use smartphone-based system that estimates grapevine pruning weight using structured light and computer vision.

item.title: ViViD-5K: A Dataset and Model for Grape Cluster and Berry Segmentation
item.description: ViViD-5K is a large annotated image dataset and segmentation pipeline designed to automate grape cluster closure analysis in vineyards using computer vision.

item.title: Low-Cost, Computer Vision-Based, Prebloom Cluster Count Prediction in Vineyards
item.description: We developed a computer vision system that uses videos taken with a smartphone to estimate grape yield more accurately and efficiently than traditional manual counting methods.

item.title: Deep Learning Approaches for Crop Disease Detection in Precision Agriculture
item.description: A deep learning framework achieving 95.3% accuracy in automated crop disease detection using CNNs with attention mechanisms, validated through extensive field trials.

item.title: Prebloom Cluster Count Prediction in Vineyards
item.description: A low-cost, computer vision pipeline that counts grape clusters before flowering using just a smartphone and AI.
